title: Integer cochain complexes form a Grothendieck abelian category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] in a fixed universe. Then the category $\operatorname{Ch}(\mathcal A)$ of integer-indexed cochain complexes, with objects $(X^n,d^n)_{n\in\mathbf Z}$ satisfying $d^{n+1}d^n=0$ and degreewise maps commuting with the differentials, is a Grothendieck abelian category in the same universe of morphisms.
